<title>발표 카운트다운</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  :root{
    --bg-0:#0b0b0c;
    --bg-1:#151517;
    --bg-2:#1e1e21;
    --line:#2c2c30;
    --ink:#f2f1ed;
    --ink-dim:#9a9a9f;
    --ink-faint:#5c5c61;
    --accent:#e50914;
    --accent-hover:#ff1f2d;
    --accent-soft:rgba(229,9,20,.14);
    --danger:#ff2a2a;
    --font-display:'Bebas Neue', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    --font-ui:'Noto Sans KR', 'Pretendard', sans-serif;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 90% at 50% 38%, var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--bg-0) 62%, #000 100%);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--font-ui);
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  .screen{
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:clamp(28px, 4vh, 56px);
    padding:8vh 6vw 12vh;
    text-align:center;
    position:relative;
  }

  .eyebrow{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .eyebrow .mark{
    font-family:var(--font-display);
    font-size:clamp(15px, 1.6vw, 20px);
    letter-spacing:.42em;
    color:var(--accent);
    text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .eyebrow .sub{
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:.28em;
    color:var(--ink-faint);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:500;
  }

  .timer-wrap{
    position:relative;
    line-height:1;
  }
  .timer{
    font-family:var(--font-display);
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:clamp(150px, 17vw, 320px);
    line-height:.94;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    color:var(--ink);
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    transition:color .25s ease, text-shadow .25s ease;
    user-select:none;
    text-wrap:balance;
  }
  .timer .colon{
    display:inline-block;
    color:var(--ink-faint);
    padding:0 clamp(4px,.6vw,14px);
  }

  .timer.is-warning{
    color:var(--danger);
    animation:blink-urgent 1s steps(1,end) infinite;
    text-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(255,42,42,.55), 0 0 120px rgba(255,42,42,.25);
  }

  @keyframes blink-urgent{
    0%, 49%{ opacity:1; }
    50%, 100%{ opacity:.28; }
  }

  .timer.is-done{
    color:var(--accent);
    animation:done-flash 1.1s ease-in-out 3;
  }
  @keyframes done-flash{
    0%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
    35%{ opacity:.15; transform:scale(.985); }
    70%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.015); }
    100%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
  }

  .status-line{
    min-height:22px;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:.14em;
    color:var(--ink-faint);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:500;
  }
  .status-line.is-done{
    color:var(--accent);
    font-weight:700;
  }

  .controls{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:22px;
  }

  .row{
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    justify-content:center;
  }

  button{
    font-family:var(--font-ui);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    background:var(--bg-2);
    color:var(--ink);
    cursor:pointer;
    border-radius:999px;
    transition:background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .12s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, color .18s ease;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  }
  button:focus-visible{
    outline:2px solid var(--accent);
    outline-offset:3px;
  }
  button:active{ transform:scale(.96); }

  .chip{
    padding:11px 26px;
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:500;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
  }
  .chip:hover{
    background:var(--bg-1);
    border-color:#3a3a3f;
  }
  .chip.is-active{
    background:var(--accent-soft);
    border-color:var(--accent);
    color:#ff8086;
  }

  .transport{
    padding:15px 40px;
    font-size:16px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.03em;
  }
  .transport.primary{
    background:var(--accent);
    border-color:var(--accent);
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px -8px rgba(229,9,20,.65);
  }
  .transport.primary:hover:not(:disabled){
    background:var(--accent-hover);
    border-color:var(--accent-hover);
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px -6px rgba(255,31,45,.75);
  }
  .transport.ghost:hover{
    background:var(--bg-1);
    border-color:#3a3a3f;
    color:#fff;
  }
  .transport:disabled{
    opacity:.35;
    cursor:not-allowed;
  }

  .progress-rail{
    position:fixed;
    left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
    height:5px;
    background:var(--bg-2);
    z-index:5;
  }
  .progress-fill{
    height:100%;
    width:0%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-hover), var(--accent));
    transition:width .3s linear;
  }
  .progress-fill.is-warning{
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--danger), var(--danger));
  }

  .sr-only{
    position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px;
    padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden;
    clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .timer.is-warning{ animation:none; text-shadow:none; }
    .timer.is-done{ animation:none; }
    button{ transition:background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease; }
    button:active{ transform:none; }
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px){
    .transport{ padding:14px 28px; }
  }
</style>

<div class="screen">
  <div class="eyebrow">
    <div class="mark">Presentation Countdown</div>
    <div class="sub">발표 카운트다운</div>
  </div>

  <div class="timer-wrap">
    <div class="timer" id="timer" role="timer" aria-live="off">05<span class="colon">:</span>00</div>
  </div>

  <div class="status-line" id="statusLine">준비됨 · 5분</div>

  <div class="controls">
    <div class="row" id="presetRow">
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-minutes="1">1분</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-minutes="3">3분</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip is-active" data-minutes="5">5분</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <button type="button" class="transport primary" id="startBtn">시작</button>
      <button type="button" class="transport ghost" id="stopBtn" disabled>정지</button>
      <button type="button" class="transport ghost" id="resetBtn">리셋</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <span class="sr-only" id="srAnnounce" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>

<div class="progress-rail"><div class="progress-fill" id="progressFill"></div></div>

<audio id="beepAudio" preload="auto" src="data:audio/wav;base64,"></audio>

<script>
(function(){
  var timerEl = document.getElementById('timer');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('statusLine');
  var startBtn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
  var stopBtn = document.getElementById('stopBtn');
  var resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
  var presetRow = document.getElementById('presetRow');
  var progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
  var srAnnounce = document.getElementById('srAnnounce');
  var beepAudio = document.getElementById('beepAudio');

  var totalSeconds = 300;
  var remainingSeconds = 300;
  var isRunning = false;
  var isDone = false;
  var rafId = null;
  var deadline = null;
  var defaultTitle = document.title;

  function format(sec){
    var s = Math.max(0, Math.round(sec));
    var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    var r = s % 60;
    var mm = String(m).padStart(2, '0');
    var ss = String(r).padStart(2, '0');
    return { mm: mm, ss: ss, text: mm + ':' + ss };
  }

  function render(){
    var f = format(remainingSeconds);
    timerEl.innerHTML = f.mm + '<span class="colon">:</span>' + f.ss;
    document.title = isRunning ? ('(' + f.text + ') 발표 카운트다운') : defaultTitle;

    var pct = totalSeconds > 0 ? ((totalSeconds - remainingSeconds) / totalSeconds) * 100 : 0;
    progressFill.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, pct)) + '%';

    var warning = remainingSeconds > 0 && remainingSeconds < 10;
    timerEl.classList.toggle('is-warning', warning);
    progressFill.classList.toggle('is-warning', warning);

    if (isDone){
      statusEl.textContent = '시간 종료';
      statusEl.classList.add('is-done');
    } else if (isRunning){
      statusEl.textContent = warning ? '곧 종료됩니다' : '발표 진행 중';
      statusEl.classList.remove('is-done');
    } else if (remainingSeconds === totalSeconds){
      statusEl.textContent = '준비됨 · ' + Math.round(totalSeconds/60) + '분';
      statusEl.classList.remove('is-done');
    } else {
      statusEl.textContent = '일시정지';
      statusEl.classList.remove('is-done');
    }
  }

  function announce(text){
    srAnnounce.textContent = text;
  }

  function tick(){
    if (!isRunning) return;
    var now = Date.now();
    remainingSeconds = Math.max(0, (deadline - now) / 1000);
    if (remainingSeconds <= 0){
      remainingSeconds = 0;
      render();
      finish();
      return;
    }
    render();
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function setActivePreset(minutes){
    var chips = presetRow.querySelectorAll('.chip');
    for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++){
      var m = parseInt(chips[i].getAttribute('data-minutes'), 10);
      chips[i].classList.toggle('is-active', m === minutes);
    }
  }

  function setDuration(minutes){
    stop();
    totalSeconds = minutes * 60;
    remainingSeconds = totalSeconds;
    isDone = false;
    timerEl.classList.remove('is-done', 'is-warning');
    setActivePreset(minutes);
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    render();
    announce(minutes + '분으로 설정되었습니다');
  }

  function start(){
    if (isRunning || remainingSeconds <= 0) return;
    isRunning = true;
    isDone = false;
    timerEl.classList.remove('is-done');
    deadline = Date.now() + remainingSeconds * 1000;
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    stopBtn.disabled = false;
    render();
    announce('타이머 시작');
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function stop(){
    if (!isRunning){ return; }
    isRunning = false;
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = null;
    startBtn.disabled = remainingSeconds <= 0;
    stopBtn.disabled = true;
    render();
    announce('타이머 정지');
  }

  function reset(){
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = null;
    isRunning = false;
    isDone = false;
    remainingSeconds = totalSeconds;
    timerEl.classList.remove('is-done', 'is-warning');
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    stopBtn.disabled = true;
    render();
    announce('타이머가 초기화되었습니다');
  }

  function finish(){
    isRunning = false;
    isDone = true;
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = null;
    timerEl.classList.remove('is-warning');
    timerEl.classList.add('is-done');
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    stopBtn.disabled = true;
    render();
    announce('시간이 종료되었습니다');
    try {
      beepAudio.currentTime = 0;
      var p = beepAudio.play();
      if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function(){ /* autoplay may be blocked until first interaction */ });
    } catch(e){}
  }

  presetRow.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('.chip');
    if (!btn) return;
    setDuration(parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-minutes'), 10));
  });

  startBtn.addEventListener('click', start);
  stopBtn.addEventListener('click', stop);
  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', reset);

  render();
})();
</script>
